meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

copy.tagline: 用Adaptyv API设计蛋白质实验并获取结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计蛋白质实验并获取实验数据
copy.tagline_en: Design protein experiments and retrieve results using Adaptyv API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design protein experiments and retrieve experimental data

howto.what: Claude 会按 Adaptyv 官方接口，根据蛋白序列设计并提交结合、热稳定性等实验，并查询报价、返回实验链接、状态与结果数据。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Adaptyv、蛋白结合/筛选、热稳定性检测等，或要求提交蛋白序列/代码出现 adaptyv、FoundryClient 时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 EGFR 靶点，准备做 BLI 结合筛选。
say.note: 会先列出目标并给出费用预估。

say.text: 用这段序列创建 PD-L1 结合筛选实验并提交。
say.note: 会创建草稿并走提交、报价流程。

say.text: 查看我上次实验的状态，结果出来了吗？
say.note: 会读取实验状态与结果数据。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Adaptyv Foundry API and Python SDK to design protein experiments, submit sequences, estimate costs, and retrieve results (binding/thermostability/expression/fluorescence). Reads API keys from env/.env; lists/filters targets.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions Adaptyv, binding/screening, or thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences; also on imports of adaptyv/FoundryClient or the foundry-api URL.

say_en.text: Help me find EGFR targets for a BLI binding screen.
say_en.note: Lists targets and gives a cost estimate.

say_en.text: Create and submit a PD-L1 binding screening experiment with this sequence.
say_en.note: Creates a draft and submits it for a quote.

say_en.text: What's the status of my last experiment? Are results ready?
say_en.note: Reads the experiment status and results data.
